company.description:
Freterium is a collaborative SaaS that connects organizations, people and technologies in the logistics value chain to help them move things.

Their cloud-based transport management platform offers the easiest and most automated way for manufacturers, retailers and logistics providers, to manage their daily road freight shipments.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based transport management system that integrates transport planning, real-time visibility, and analytics to manage logistics flows and optimize transport operations.

productsAndServices.description: Configurable algorithms that automate and optimize transport planning to reduce costs and errors while improving operational efficiency.

productsAndServices.description: A digital interface that provides customers and suppliers with access to transport information and collaboration tools within the logistics network.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,000,000, or 89.79% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,309,612 to $19,319,782, a 5.84x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Transporeon, MercuryGate International, Manhattan Associates.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
